patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed image sections with text overlays and solid-color background sections with large, bold typography, creating distinct visual breaks.
Extreme typographic contrast is used, featuring oversized, heavy sans-serif headings for impact, paired with much smaller, lighter sans-serif body text for readability.

A vibrant pastel secondary palette (light yellow, light blue, light pink) is consistently applied to section backgrounds, providing energetic visual segmentation against a neutral white and black base.
The hero section employs a subtle parallax effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text and call-to-action, creating a sense of depth.
Case studies are presented in a two-column grid format, each featuring a distinct image and a 'View the case' call-to-action, breaking the full-width section flow.
The site uses full-width, distinct background color or image sections to clearly delineate content blocks and guide the user through different topics.

technique_notes: The navigation bar is designed to remain fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, ensuring persistent access to site navigation.
The hero image creates a sense of depth by moving at a slower speed than the foreground content during vertical scrolling, a classic parallax effect.
Content sections are revealed by simply scrolling into view, without explicit fade-in or slide-up animations; elements appear as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create a bold statement, contrasted with small, readable sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle radius on buttons and some interactive elements; otherwise, sharp corners dominate the overall layout.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with airy sections for hero and main statements, transitioning to a denser grid for case studies and service listings.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, heavy sans-serif typography for key statements, combined with a vibrant, almost neon, pastel color palette for section backgrounds, creates a bold and playful yet professional aesthetic. The design avoids generic layouts by integrating full-bleed imagery and unique section breaks.
